claim_boundary: Stage 2J tests hidden-position specificity against delta/activation matched controls. It does not establish CLT feature-level source-control route replication.

llava.reading: LLaVA remains clearly above activation-matched controls, but delta-matched controls absorb much of the restore/corrupt effect; write as partial specificity rather than strong matched-control specificity.

qwen.reading: Qwen remains positive over delta/activation matched controls, with strongest support in restore and visual-only comparisons; corrupt combo vs activation is weaker.
